subject: ddl: pessimistic lock global id, alloc id & insert ddl job in one txn (#54547)
summary: Moves DDL job submission (job-table path) to a single pessimistic transaction that locks the meta global-ID key, allocates job IDs, and inserts rows atomically with retry; adds `meta.Meta.GlobalIDKey()` to lock the exact encoded key and exports `kv.MaxRetryCnt` for shared retry limits. Later history on `upstream/master` shows follow-up refactors and min-job-id querying work, but no clear bug-fix indicating a remaining Blocker/High issue in this change.
